name: Luxus Hunza Attabad Lake Resort
highlight: Attabad Lake-front views; spa, sauna, fitness center; the most-publicized 5-star resort in the valley
pros: Direct turquoise Attabad Lake frontage and dramatic mountain backdrop
Full spa/wellness facilities (sauna, steam room, hot tub) rare for the region
Strong marks for staff attentiveness and cleanliness
cons: Recurring guest complaints about sewage smell in some rooms
Sits at Aina Abad on the lake, ~45 min from Karimabad's town/forts
take: The closest thing Hunza has to a true luxury lake resort, with knockout views; just temper expectations on maintenance versus the 5-star billing. (TripAdvisor scores it lower, ~3/5 from 70 reviews.)

name: Hunza Serena Hotel
highlight: Polished international-brand service in the heart of Karimabad with valley and Rakaposhi views
pros: Most consistent, professional service of any Karimabad hotel (Serena-managed)
Central Karimabad location with terrace/restaurant views and a spa
Clean, comfortable rooms with reliable amenities
cons: Some guests find rooms smaller/less grand than other Serena properties
take: The safest high-end pick inside Karimabad itself; ranked #2 of 11 hotels in Karimabad on Tripadvisor and rated up to 9.4-9.8 on booking platforms.

name: Serena Altit Fort Residence
highlight: Heritage stay beside Altit Fort with the treehouse-style Kha Basi cafe and complimentary fort tour
pros: Quiet, historic Altit setting away from Karimabad's bustle
Phenomenal valley views and the standout Kha Basi cafe
Complimentary Altit Fort tour for in-house guests
cons: Described as a temporary/interim property while Serena's permanent Hunza hotel is built
Very small (only a handful of reviews so far)
take: A characterful heritage residence for travelers who want history and calm over resort scale; #1 of 1 inn in Altit on Tripadvisor.

name: Eagle's Nest Hotel
highlight: Duikar viewpoint above Karimabad with the valley's most famous Rakaposhi and Lady Finger panorama
pros: Arguably the single best sunrise/sunset viewpoint of any hotel in Hunza (Duikar)
Rooms and terrace face Rakaposhi, Lady Finger and the whole valley
Owners/staff repeatedly described as warm and welcoming
cons: Recurring complaints about management/service and only average food
Up a steep road well above Karimabad town
take: You stay here for the legendary Duikar view, not the service; #3 of 17 Hunza hotels on Tripadvisor with notably mixed reviews.

name: Hunza Embassy Hotel
highlight: Long-running Karimabad hotel with terraces overlooking the valley and a well-liked restaurant
pros: Most rooms have private terraces with sweeping valley views
On-site restaurant praised for tasty food and helpful staff
Reliable hot water and central Karimabad location
cons: Rooms can get very hot in July/August
Reports of unreliable Wi-Fi and patchy cleanliness/upkeep
take: A solid old-guard mid-range choice for the view and the food, but somewhat dated; rated ~3.4/5 from 54 Tripadvisor reviews.

name: Baltit Heritage Inn
highlight: Walkable to Baltit Fort with clean rooms and mountain views at fair value
pros: Excellent location steps from Baltit Fort and Karimabad's restaurants
Clean, comfortable rooms with mountain views
Helpful, accommodating staff and good value
cons: Electricity and Wi-Fi can be unstable (common across Hunza)
take: A dependable, good-value base for exploring Karimabad on foot; guest rating around 8.0/10.

name: Old Hunza Inn
highlight: Backpacker institution since 1981 run by owner 'Leo', great views and traveler hub vibe
pros: Among the cheapest beds in Karimabad with clean rooms and hot showers
Spectacular mountain/glacier views on a quiet edge of town
Owner Leo and the social, info-sharing atmosphere are a real draw
cons: Basic, simple rooms (it's a backpacker guesthouse, not a hotel)
take: The classic budget pick in Hunza for value, views and meeting other travelers; rated ~8.5/10 on Booking.com.

name: Hunza Marcopolo Inn
highlight: 40+ year-old Gulmit inn with orchards and Passu Cones views; the main stay option in Gulmit
pros: Magnificent views of the Passu Cones from a peaceful Gulmit setting
Hands-on GM and personal hospitality frequently praised
Orchard grounds, 24-hr hot water and on-site restaurant
cons: Not recommended in winter (running-water issues in cold months)
take: The established, characterful choice if you want to base in Gulmit near the Passu Cones, with mixed reviews on upkeep.

name: Passu Tourist Lodge
highlight: Quiet year-round lodge with front-row Passu Cones views on the Karakoram Highway
pros: Superb, isolated views of the Passu Cones and snow peaks
Friendly, English-speaking staff and calm atmosphere
Open year-round, unlike many Hunza hotels that close in winter
cons: Simple lodge-style rooms and limited amenities
Remote Passu location, far from Karimabad's sights
take: The best-reviewed base in Passu for trekkers and Cones-chasers wanting quiet and value; ~4.1/5 from 71 Tripadvisor reviews.
